answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The velvet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the nebula. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zephyr of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
